caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a natural brown hue, featuring three horizontal slats on the backrest that are slightly curved. The chair has armrests that are supported by turned wooden supports, and the armrests themselves are also brown to match the chair. The legs and stretchers of the chair are cylindrical and have decorative turned elements. The seat appears to be woven from a light tan material, possibly rush or straw, distinct in both texture and color from the smooth wood. The overall composition centers the chair against a simple, off-white background with no additional objects or patterns. The artist's signature, "Frank Weninger," is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Armchair
